maui.name: County of Maui Real Property Assessment Division - ArcGIS Online feature service "Sales" (service description: "2 Year Sales FY 2024 - 2025"; backs the county Comparable Sales dashboard/Equitable Property Value hub)
maui.join: District and residential-unit count from County of Maui PARCELINFO layer (raw/owners_neighbor/maui/parcelinfo/*.json, 81,581 parcels, joined on 12-digit PARID; 1500/1500 matched)

notes.coverage_maui: NOT the full recorded-sales universe. Layer holds only the county assessor's VALID (arm's-length) sales used for the TY2025 and TY2026 assessments: sale dates 2023-03-04..2025-06-30 (all but 26 rows fall Jul-2023..Jun-2025). All 1500 PARIDs end in 0000 = whole fee-simple parcels; NO CPR units, so NO condos (and no CPR'd houses) are in this data. Sale codes present: Valid Sale, Valid mult bldgs, Developer sale, Valid sale w/ adj price. Non-arm's-length/nominal deeds were already excluded by the county.
notes.periods: by_assess_window = the two complete 12-month windows (TY2025: Jul2023-Jun2024; TY2026: Jul2024-Jun2025) - use these for comparisons. by_year = calendar year of sale date: 2023 is partial (effectively Jul-Dec plus 4 earlier sales), 2024 complete, 2025 = Jan-Jun only. 2019-2022 and 2025H2/2026 YTD: NOT AVAILABLE from any county source reached.
notes.cleaning: Dropped 3 rows < $50,000 (1500 -> 1497 rows). Multi-parcel dedupe: rows sharing sale date + price + zone/section/plat (first 5 digits of PARID) counted as one deal: 3 deals spanned >1 parcel, giving 1493 deals.
notes.property_type: house = SALETYPE Improved/Fix with >=1 residential unit on parcel (PARCELINFO RES_COUNT); land = SALETYPE Vacant; other_improved = improved with no residential unit (commercial/ag/industrial). Condo: not present in source. Note RES_COUNT and tax class are current (2026) attributes, not at-sale.
notes.district_mapping: From PARCELINFO CITYNAME (postal city): LAHAINA->West Maui (incl. Kaanapali/Napili/Kapalua, all 96761); KIHEI/MAKENA->South Maui (incl. Wailea, 96753); MAKAWAO/KULA/PUKALANI->Upcountry; WAILUKU/KAHULUI/PUUNENE->Central (WAILUKU postal area also includes Waikapu, Waihee, Maalaea); HAIKU/PAIA/HANA/KEANAE->Haiku/Paia/Hana; KAUNAKAKAI/MAUNALOA/HOOLEHUA/KUALAPUU->Molokai; LANAI->Lanai. Enclave-level split (Wailea vs Kihei, Kapalua vs Lahaina) not possible from postal city.
notes.tiers: entry < $750K; mid $750K-<1.5M; upper $1.5M-<3M; luxury $3M-<10M; ultra >= $10M; n_1m_plus/n_3m_plus/n_5m_plus/n_10m_plus are >= thresholds. Medians are of deal prices (statistics.median).
notes.privacy: No owner names or street addresses output. salekey = county sale record key from the layer, included only so a verifier can re-find each top sale in the raw file.
